# Behavioral matrix for src/supervisor/prd-oracle-lint.ts's RULES.
# Format: <ruleName> :: <ok|flag> :: <command>
# '#' comments and blank lines are ignored. US-001 (CAM-388) seeded the
# frozen-comparand and rotating-artifact-target rows; US-002 (CAM-388)
# broadened the matrix to cover all four rules with both directions (ok and
# flag), so this fixture cannot be narrowed back into vacuity without a
# future story visibly deleting rows. Known accepted blind spot (recorded in
# scripts/cam/patterns.md): frozen-comparand's quote-stripping intentionally
# blinds it to a live comparison embedded in a non-`-c` interpreter payload
# (e.g. `bun -e '...'`) -- `-c` is unwrapped but `-e` is not.
# US-003 (CAM-382) promoted the INNER test-input strings from
# test/fixtures/oracle-lint/cam382-false-positives.txt (the wrapper `bun -e`/
# `grep -qF` commands are already rows above; their `-e` payload is not
# scanned by the rule, so the wrapper form alone never exercises the rule
# against the inner strings) into their own rows below, so this defect can
# never again be a tracked-but-unrun reproduction.
frozen-comparand :: ok :: bun -e 'const cs=["test $X -eq 41","test $X -ge 41"];for(const c of cs){console.log(c)}'
frozen-comparand :: ok :: grep -qF 'test $(git grep -c PATTERN mainbranch:file.ts) -eq 1' test/supervisor/prd-oracle-lint.test.ts
frozen-comparand :: flag :: test $(wc -l < scripts/cam/patterns.md) -eq 42
frozen-comparand :: flag :: sh -c 'test $(wc -l < scripts/cam/patterns.md) -eq 42'
frozen-comparand :: flag :: sh -c 'echo '\''hi'\''; test $(wc -l < f) -eq 3'
frozen-comparand :: flag :: printf '%s' a'b; test $(wc -l < f) -eq 7
frozen-comparand :: ok :: grep -c 'test $X -eq 41' file.ts
frozen-comparand :: ok :: npx tool -c 'threshold -eq 5'
frozen-comparand :: flag :: bash -c "echo \"hi\"; test $(wc -l < f) -eq 3"
frozen-comparand :: flag :: sh -c "test \"$X\" -eq 3"
frozen-comparand :: ok :: test $(wc -l < "$(git show main:f.ts)") -eq 42
frozen-comparand :: flag :: test $X -eq 41
frozen-comparand :: flag :: test $X -ge 41
frozen-comparand :: flag :: test $X -le 41
frozen-comparand :: flag :: test $X == 41
frozen-comparand :: flag :: test $(git grep -c PATTERN mainbranch:file.ts) -eq 1
frozen-comparand :: ok :: cmd --ge 5
frozen-comparand :: ok :: echo foo-eq 42
frozen-comparand :: ok :: run --eq 7
frozen-comparand :: ok :: test $(foo-eq 42)
frozen-comparand :: flag :: test $(git grep -c PATTERN main.ts) -eq 3
frozen-comparand :: flag :: test $(git grep -c PATTERN src/main.rs) -eq 3
grep-q-plus-list-files :: ok :: grep -q 'PATTERN' file.ts
grep-q-plus-list-files :: flag :: grep -Lq 'PATTERN' file.ts
rotating-artifact-target :: ok :: grep -q 'ROTATING_ARTIFACT_RULE' src/supervisor/prd-oracle-lint.ts
rotating-artifact-target :: flag :: cat 'scripts/cam/handoff.json' | grep -q retryBaseMs
zero-match-vacuous :: ok :: L=$(grep -n PATTERN FILE | head -1 | cut -d: -f1); test -n "$L" && sed -n "${L}p" FILE | grep -q X
zero-match-vacuous :: flag :: L=$(grep -n PATTERN FILE | head -1 | cut -d: -f1); sed -n "${L}p" FILE | grep -q SOMETHING
